lines.trans: For fifteen years in my hands, this wooden board only ever held hooks one through eight.
Look on the right edge—there were two tiny screw holes under the varnish all along.
No way! Thirty years ago, hook number nine hung right there!
One turn, two turns... solid brass hook number nine, back home where it belongs.
May I hang the big sunroom key up on it myself, Chen?
Go right ahead, Qing. You earned it with all your hard work this week.
Wait—Chen, what is that laminated card tucked inside your paper ledger?
Aha! Did you secretly keep a copy of my printed café menu, Chen?!
Only because your big numbers are easy to read clearly without turning on a lamp.
Write this day down in the guest book: Chen praised a printed page!
Don't celebrate too much, boss. When it rains, paper books still win.
Look at the courtyard clock—half past five! Let us go light the lanterns!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng qù. Compound directional complement showing upward motion away from the speaker.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià yǔ. Literally 'fall rain'; Mandarin expresses weather with verb + weather noun.

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

examples.text: 你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.

examples.text: 这是不用。
examples.trans: This is 不用.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ. Cardinal number 5.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīn shǒu. Highlights personal care in making, baking, or carving something.

examples.text: 拆开白纸……不会吧！爷爷亲手雕的木头火车头！
examples.trans: Unwrap the white paper... no way! Grandfather's hand-carved wooden locomotive!

examples.text: 这块柠檬蛋糕是她亲手烤的。
examples.trans: She baked this lemon cake with her own hands.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天一天 ('all day today').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

份.gloss: measure word for portions, copies, jobs

meanings.en: measure word for portions, copies, jobs
meanings.note: Pinyin: fèn. Counts documents, newspapers, meals, and shares (一份文件 'a document').

examples.text: 整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
examples.trans: We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.

examples.text: 请再给我一份早餐。
examples.trans: Please bring me one more portion of breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Adverb tōutōu ('on the sly, quietly').

examples.text: 他偷偷在台脚放了一颗宝石。
examples.trans: He secretly put a gem by the stage edge.

examples.text: 小猫偷偷跑进了房间。
examples.trans: The kitten quietly slipped into the room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā. Cardinal number 8.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Numeral shíwǔ ('fifteen').

examples.text: 方案会还有十五分钟就要开始了。
examples.trans: The proposal meeting starts in fifteen minutes.

examples.text: 中场休息一共是十五分钟。
examples.trans: Intermission lasts fifteen minutes in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn. Follows a measure word for 'and a half' (七点半 '7:30') or precedes a measure word for 'half a' (半个小时).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Small paper card for notes, gifts, or study.

examples.text: 礼物盒里放着一张小卡片。
examples.trans: Inside the gift box sits a small card.

examples.text: 他在卡片上写了几句祝福。
examples.trans: He wrote a few wishes on the card.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Read zhǐ as the adverb 'only' before verbs, and zhī as a measure word for cups, boxes, and small animals.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ shì. Softens an explanation ('I simply…').

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 我只是检查安全。这是我的工作。
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ké yǐ. Polite modal verb for asking or granting permission (可以吗？ 'Is that alright?').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 阁楼书房？我可以先上去看看吗？
examples.trans: An attic study? May I go up and see it first?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái dēng. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏台灯 ('a desk lamp').

examples.text: 好：有床、桌子和椅子，可是没有床头台灯。
examples.trans: Okay: there is a bed, a table, and a chair, yet no bedside lamp.

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 右边 ('the right side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi guǎn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家咖啡馆 ('a café').

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 比现在翻一倍！我们真的要对整条街开放小院咖啡馆吗？
examples.trans: Double what I bake now! Are we really opening the courtyard café to our whole street?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hā. Expresses sudden realization or cheerful laughter.

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 哈，原来钥匙就在口袋里！
examples.trans: Aha, the key was in my pocket all along!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí jiā. Verb-object compound 回 ('return') + 家 ('home'); takes no location particle between them.

examples.text: 买完菜以后，我们一起走路回家吧。
examples.trans: After finishing the grocery shopping, let's walk home together.

examples.text: 下班回家的路上，我买了一束鲜花。
examples.trans: On my way home from work, I bought a bunch of fresh flowers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn wèi. Introduces a reason; often paired with 所以 ('therefore') in the next clause.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quān. Counts full turns of a key, wrench, or lap around a block (一圈 'one full turn').

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 我绕着广场走了一圈。
examples.trans: I walked one lap around the square.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

块.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

meanings.en: measure word for pieces and yuan
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. Counts chunks/pieces (一块蛋糕 'a piece of cake') and spoken yuan of money (五块钱 'five yuan').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sù fēng. Combines 塑 ('plastic') + 封 ('seal'); often used attributively (塑封卡片 'laminated card').

examples.text: 老陈，你账本里夹着的那张塑封卡片是什么？
examples.trans: Chen, what is that laminated card tucked inside your ledger?

examples.text: 小晴把新印好的咖啡馆菜单塑封起来，就不怕茶水弄湿了。
examples.trans: Qing laminated the newly printed café menus so spilled tea cannot get them wet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài. Often frames 太 + adj + 了 for warm exclamations (太好了！ 'Wonderful!').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 每位住客都夸陈师傅烤的面包卷又香又脆。
examples.trans: Every guest praises Master Chen's baked rolls for being fragrant and crisp.

examples.text: 大家都夸小美年纪轻轻却把客栈打理得井井有条。
examples.trans: Everyone praises Mei for running the guesthouse in such orderly fashion at such a young age.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. First-tone jiā: hold something pinched between two surfaces, such as under one's arm (夹在胳膊底下) or inside book pages.

examples.text: 周经理把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下走来走去。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou paced back and forth with the green guest book tucked under his arm.

examples.text: 她在旧书里夹了一片干树叶做书签。
examples.trans: She tucked a dried leaf inside the old book as a bookmark.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒng. Used for small neat holes such as screw holes (螺丝孔) or keyholes (钥匙孔); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 您看右边——清漆下面本来就有两个小小的螺丝孔。
examples.trans: Look on the right—there were two tiny screw holes under the clear varnish all along.

examples.text: 老陈往旧锁孔里滴了一点油，钥匙立刻就转得顺畅了。
examples.trans: Chen put a drop of oil into the old keyhole, and the key turned smoothly right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo xiǎo. Reduplication of 小 ('small'); adds a vivid, affectionate nuance ('tiny little').

examples.text: 您看右边——清漆下面本来就有两个小小的螺丝孔。
examples.trans: Look on the right—there were two tiny screw holes under the clear varnish all along.

examples.text: 每个小玻璃瓶里都插着一片小小的绿柠檬叶。
examples.trans: A tiny green lemon leaf is tucked inside each small glass jar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Locative noun shǒulǐ ('in hand').

examples.text: 大家都先放下手里的活。
examples.trans: Everyone put down the work in your hands first.

examples.text: 光杏子手里就握着不少艺人资源。
examples.trans: Xingzi alone holds plenty of artist contacts in her hands.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ yìn. Combines 打 ('strike/produce') + 印 ('print/stamp'); 打印纸 is printer paper.

examples.text: 哈！老陈，你偷偷留了一份我打印的咖啡馆菜单？！
examples.trans: Aha! Did you secretly keep a copy of my printed café menu, Chen?!

examples.text: 小晴用前台的打印机打印了二十份新菜单。
examples.trans: Qing printed twenty copies of the new menu on the front-desk printer.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà. Used for hanging keys, coats, lanterns, or hanging up a phone.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà zhōng. Combines 挂 ('hang on a wall') + 钟 ('clock').

examples.text: 前台后面的老挂钟每到整点就会轻轻敲响。
examples.trans: The old wall clock behind the front desk chimes softly every hour on the hour.

examples.text: 老陈修好了大堂里那座停了很久的挂钟。
examples.trans: Chen repaired the wall clock in the lobby that had been stopped for a long time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà gōu. Combines 挂 ('hang') + 钩 ('hook'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 这块木板在我手里十五年，一直只有一到八号挂钩。
examples.trans: For fifteen years in my hands, this wooden board only ever had hooks one through eight.

examples.text: 老陈把擦亮的九号黄铜挂钩稳稳拧在木板右边。
examples.trans: Chen screwed the polished brass number-nine hook firmly onto the right side of the wooden board.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个数字 ('a number / digit').

examples.text: 全是灰色小数字！我看到第一页心就停了！
examples.trans: Nothing but tiny grey numbers! My heart stopped at page one!

examples.text: 把上面铜牌的灰尘擦掉……等等，快念那个数字！
examples.trans: Brush the dust off the brass plate on top... wait, read that number!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo. Alone as a greeting, 早！ means a brisk, friendly 'Morning!'.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期 ('a week').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù bǎn. Combines 木 ('wood') + 板 ('board/plank'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 这块木板在我手里十五年，一直只有一到八号挂钩。
examples.trans: For fifteen years in my hands, this wooden board only ever held hooks one through eight.

examples.text: 老陈挑了两块干燥的厚木板来做新书架。
examples.trans: Chen picked out two thick dry wooden boards to build the new bookshelf.

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn zi. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本本子 ('a notebook').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn lái. Indicates what was originally planned or true.

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算让店员把箱子交给他，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you were planning to let the clerk hand him the bag and watch from across the street?!

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng chu. Describes clear speech, clear handwriting, or hearing clearly (听得很清楚).

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

examples.text: 这三年我很想你。真诚又清楚。第三句呢？
examples.trans: I missed you very much these three years. Honest and clear. And the third line?

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qī. Combines 清 ('clear/transparent') + 漆 ('lacquer/varnish').

examples.text: 您看右边——清漆下面本来就有两个小小的螺丝孔。
examples.trans: Look on the right—there were two tiny screw holes under the clear varnish all along.

examples.text: 刷上一层薄薄的清漆以后，老木头的纹理更漂亮了。
examples.trans: After brushing on a thin coat of clear varnish, the grain of the old wood looks even lovelier.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午挂纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng jì běn. Compound 登记 ('register / check in') + 本 ('bound book'). Measure word: 本 (běn).

examples.text: 每一位住店的客人都要在前台登记本上签字。
examples.trans: Every guest staying at the inn signs the register book at the front desk.

examples.text: 阁楼木箱里保存着三十年前的绿色客人登记本。
examples.trans: A green guest register from thirty years ago is preserved in the attic wooden chest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē shi. Note first tone jiē + neutral shi ('solidly built').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
examples.trans: Good spot. Two sturdy chairs, facing the plants rather than the lobby window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: láo bǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老板 ('a boss / shop owner').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

related.gloss: a boss / shop owner (measure word 位)

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cài dān. Combines 菜 ('dishes/courses') + 单 ('list/sheet').

examples.text: 星期三咖啡角的开业菜单已经全部定好了！
examples.trans: Wednesday's opening menu for the café corner is all set!

examples.text: 小美用漂亮的手写字把今日菜单抄在木牌上。
examples.trans: Mei copied today's menu onto the wooden board in neat handwriting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó sī. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗螺丝 ('a screw').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Used both for jotting down notes (记下) and holding in memory (记住).

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàng běn. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本账本 ('an account ledger').

examples.text: 说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
examples.trans: Right you are. Paperwork can wait—set it beside the ledger for now.

examples.text: 每天关门以前，经理都会核对一遍账本。
examples.trans: Before closing up each night, the manager checks the ledger.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng. Opposite of 输; can serve as a result complement (跑赢 'outrun / win the race').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 弟弟今天下棋赢了哥哥一次。
examples.trans: The younger brother beat his older brother once at chess today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuàn. Read zhuàn for spinning wheels or quick wits (脑子转得快 'mind works fast').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 风一吹，纸风车就飞快地转起来。
examples.trans: When the breeze blows, the paper pinwheel spins fast.

examples.text: 工作很辛苦。
examples.trans: The work is very hard.

examples.text: 大家辛苦了。
examples.trans: Thanks everyone for the hard work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái shi. Joins choices in questions (茶还是咖啡？ 'tea or coffee?') or means 'still'.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 我们不用电脑，一直用这个大纸本子记账。
examples.trans: We do not use a computer; we always use this big paper ledger to keep accounts.

examples.text: 这个木头小火车是老木匠专门为孩子们做的礼物。
examples.trans: This little wooden train is a gift made specially for the children by the old carpenter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàr. Spoken variant of 那里 ('there').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把钥匙 ('a key').

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng guāng fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间阳光房 ('a sunroom').

examples.text: 啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
examples.trans: Aha! Look here: ground floor, Room Nine, garden sunroom!

examples.text: 等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
examples.trans: Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the ground floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo xìng. Classic greeting word in 很高兴认识你 ('Nice to meet you').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 很高兴我们安静的小院子适合您的……工作。
examples.trans: We are glad our quiet courtyard suits your... work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng tóng. Literally 黄 ('yellow/golden') + 铜 ('copper/bronze'): copper-zinc brass alloy.

examples.text: 钢琴琴槌里面的细小轴销是用结实的黄铜做的。
examples.trans: The tiny hinge pins inside piano hammers are made of sturdy brass.

examples.text: 老陈把前台的黄铜小铃铛擦得金光发亮。
examples.trans: Chen polished the little brass bell on the front desk until it gleamed.
